basis: Independent source-image-only visual judgments; full-image normalized [0,1) coordinates; no calibrated ground truth.
notes: Clear pairs are plausible visual depth orderings, not measurements. Diagnostic boundary pairs have no correctness guarantee. Points were chosen on 1200x800 source previews, before access to any model output.

clear_pairs.name: subject_torso_vs_distant_town
clear_pairs.rationale: The centrally occluding subject is much nearer than town buildings visible beyond the balcony.

clear_pairs.name: left_door_panel_vs_town
clear_pairs.rationale: The doorway surrounds the camera-side balcony; buildings beyond the railing are distant.

clear_pairs.name: right_door_panel_vs_roof
clear_pairs.rationale: Door panel is foreground architecture; roof is down and beyond the balcony.

clear_pairs.name: balcony_floor_vs_building
clear_pairs.rationale: Walkable floor beneath the subject is foreground; the visible building lies beyond the balcony.

clear_pairs.name: subject_skirt_vs_background_field
clear_pairs.rationale: Subject skirt occupies the balcony; green field is beyond its railing.

diagnostic_boundary_pairs.name: hair_top_vs_sky
diagnostic_boundary_pairs.rationale: Top hair contour against sky; sparse hairs, antialiasing, and the absence of finite sky depth make this diagnostic only.

diagnostic_boundary_pairs.name: left_forearm_vs_sky
diagnostic_boundary_pairs.rationale: Narrow arm region above the town; contour precision and arm orientation affect interpretation.

diagnostic_boundary_pairs.name: railing_top_vs_background
diagnostic_boundary_pairs.rationale: Thin horizontal railing against distant landscape; subpixel placement and mixed pixels can dominate.

clear_pairs.name: central_near_road_vs_far_road
clear_pairs.rationale: On the approximately planar road, the lower image point is nearer under the evident perspective.

clear_pairs.name: right_near_road_vs_far_road
clear_pairs.rationale: Same road surface extends toward the vanishing region; small surface irregularities should not reverse this large separation.

clear_pairs.name: nearest_left_lamp_pole_vs_receding_pole
clear_pairs.rationale: The large left pole is earlier in the receding row; the smaller pole near the vanishing region is farther.

clear_pairs.name: left_foreground_car_vs_distant_vehicle
clear_pairs.rationale: Large parked car at the left foreground is nearer than the small vehicle toward the street center.

clear_pairs.name: left_tree_trunk_vs_receding_tree_trunk
clear_pairs.rationale: Trunks belong to the left sidewalk tree row; size and occlusion support the depth ordering, though exact trunk geometry is uncalibrated.

diagnostic_boundary_pairs.name: nearest_lamp_pole_vs_foliage
diagnostic_boundary_pairs.rationale: Thin pole contour against foliage; the foliage distance is less certain than road perspective and pixels can mix.

diagnostic_boundary_pairs.name: overhead_wire_vs_sky
diagnostic_boundary_pairs.rationale: Thin overhead wire against sky; normalized wire location is approximate and sky has no measured finite depth.

diagnostic_boundary_pairs.name: pedestrian_vs_background
diagnostic_boundary_pairs.rationale: Small pedestrian against roadside background; very few pixels and uncertain background distance prevent a correctness guarantee.
